what: Fox Corporation is a news and sports company. It owns Fox News, the most-watched American cable news channel, Fox Sports, the Fox broadcast network and local television stations, plus the Tubi free streaming service.
customers: Cable and streaming distributors paying carriage fees, advertisers, and viewers of its free streaming service.
money: Fox News and Fox Sports affiliate fees and advertising
the Fox broadcast network, local stations and Tubi
the Fox Studio Lot and Credible
moat: Live news and sports that viewers watch as it happens, which is the only television content advertisers still pay a premium for and distributors cannot drop.
risks: Cable subscriber decline reduces the households paying carriage fees
Sports rights costs rise at every renewal
Fox News ratings depend heavily on the political cycle
opportunities: Tubi has become one of the largest free ad-supported streaming services in the US
It avoided the expensive general-entertainment streaming war its rivals entered
watch: Affiliate fee growth and advertising revenue at Fox News and Fox Sports.
